about: Shared test vectors for the Amendment 2 names block (names[], primaryZone, namesVersion, namesStatus). CANONICAL copy: k2-connect control-plane/src/testdata/names-vectors.json (run by zones.rs names_vectors_tests). k2-dev-web keeps a byte-identical copy at tests/fixtures/names-vectors.json (run by its /api/tunnel/relays port). zoneRows null = the K2X zones read failed. Regenerate expectations: NAMES_VECTORS_BLESS=1 cargo test names_vectors.

cases.name: k2-only-free
cases.note: Today's K2X zones; label lists k2.dev only; free: one name, no turn.

cases.name: k2-and-postal-pro
cases.note: Today's zones; k2.dev + postal.bot on Pro: turn only on k2.dev.

cases.name: pending-k5-not-served
cases.note: k5.dev is pending: listed on the row but never served.

cases.name: only-pending-zone-real-read
cases.note: Real read, the label's only zone is pending: namesStatus none.

cases.name: only-pending-zone-read-failed
cases.note: The zones read failed (built-in set): no names, namesStatus omitted, never none.

cases.name: read-failed-legacy-row
cases.note: Read failed; zones/tier missing (legacy row): built-in k2.dev + postal.bot, ok.

cases.name: read-failed-pro
cases.note: Read failed; built-in set still gives turn on k2.dev for Pro.

cases.name: no-active-zone-is-a-failed-read
cases.note: A read with no active zone counts as failed (built-in set, status omitted).

cases.name: no-active-zone-builtin-names
cases.note: A read with no active zone: the built-in set serves k2.dev.

cases.name: empty-read-is-a-failed-read
cases.note: An empty zones read counts as failed.

cases.name: malformed-row-fails-read
cases.note: A row without a string status fails the whole read (built-in set; k5.dev-only label gets status omitted).

cases.name: malformed-row-builtin-names
cases.note: A malformed row fails the read: built-in names, ok.

cases.name: empty-zones-array-is-legacy
cases.note: An empty subdomains.zones = both of today's zones.

cases.name: k5-active-k2-primary
cases.note: k5.dev active: it joins after k2.dev; no turn on k5.dev.

cases.name: k5-active-k5-primary
cases.note: Relay primary k5.dev: k5.dev first and primaryZone.

cases.name: primary-not-on-label
cases.note: Label without the primary zone: primaryZone is its first zone.

cases.name: nested-label
cases.note: Nested label: only nested zones, no turn.

cases.name: nested-label-only-non-nested-zone
cases.note: Nested label in postal.bot only: none.

cases.name: reserved-explicit
cases.note: Reserved base label (api): no names, none.

cases.name: reserved-short
cases.note: Two-char label is reserved.

cases.name: reserved-numeric
cases.note: All-numeric label is reserved.

cases.name: reserved-turn-prefix
cases.note: turn- prefix is reserved.

cases.name: reserved-read-failed
cases.note: Reserved label on the built-in set: status omitted.

cases.name: turnip-not-reserved
cases.note: turnip is not the turn- prefix.

cases.name: single-tier-no-turn
cases.note: Single tier: no turn.

cases.name: tier-is-case-sensitive
cases.note: Stored tier 'Pro' is not 'pro': free, no turn.

cases.name: label-normalised
cases.note: Alice_Smith  -> alice-smith; row zones trimmed and lower-cased.

cases.name: label-garbage-becomes-user
cases.note: @@@ sanitises to 'user' (not reserved).

cases.name: label-clamped-63
cases.note: A 70-char label is clamped to 63.

cases.name: unknown-zone-on-row
cases.note: Row lists a zone that is not in K2X: none after a real read.

cases.name: features-differences
cases.note: Custom features: postal.bot with voice+mail+nested, k2.dev without voice: no turn anywhere; nested label gets both.

cases.name: features-voice-off-k2
cases.note: k2.dev voice off: no turn even on Pro.

cases.name: features-malformed
cases.note: features null / array / non-bool values: all false.

cases.name: features-missing
cases.note: features key missing on a row: all false.

cases.name: zone-rows-normalised
cases.note: Apex trimmed / lower-cased / trailing dots dropped, status trimmed + case-folded; dup and invalid apexes skipped; unknown status never served.

cases.name: zone-order
cases.note: Served order: primary first, then by apex (not the row's order).

cases.name: nested-escaping
cases.note: Nested labels are kept as stored (trimmed, ASCII lower-case only): JSON escaping must match.

cases.name: rust-trim-not-js-trim
cases.note: Rust trim drops U+0085 but keeps U+FEFF (JS String.trim does the opposite).
